title: First week of the new term
details: Registered for four modules. The database one looks heavy but the lecturer seems organised. Told myself I'd keep up with readings this time instead of cramming.

title: Lost an evening to setup
details: Spent three hours configuring my editor instead of writing the assignment. Classic. The tooling felt productive but nothing actually got built.

title: Study group worked
details: Met with two people from the course. Explaining recursion out loud made it click properly for the first time. Should do this weekly.

title: Assignment submitted late
details: Two hours past the deadline. I had the whole week. Started the night before because I kept telling myself it was small. It wasn't.

title: Ran instead of scrolling
details: Went out for 30 minutes when I felt the urge to open my phone. Came back and actually finished the reading. Small thing but it worked.

title: Quiet day, low energy
details: Nothing went wrong, nothing went right. Read a chapter, made notes, slept early. Not every day needs to be a milestone.

title: Presentation went better than expected
details: Practised twice out loud beforehand and it showed. Got a question I couldn't answer and said so instead of bluffing. That felt fine, actually.

title: Comparing myself again
details: Someone in the group has an internship lined up and I spent the evening feeling behind. Wrote down what I've actually finished this term — it's more than it felt like.
